options.name: auto_config
options.description: Allows to enable or disable auto-provisioning to automatically acquire domain name from DHCP.

options.name: auto_detect
options.description: Allows to auto detect the available NIC types used by iDRAC.

options.name: auto_negotiation
options.description: Allows iDRAC to automatically set the duplex mode and network speed.

options.name: ca_path
options.description: The Privacy Enhanced Mail (PEM) file that contains a CA certificate to be used for the validation.

options.name: dns_from_dhcp
options.description: Allows to enable DHCP to obtain DNS server address.

options.name: dns_idrac_name
options.description: Name of the DNS to register iDRAC.

options.name: duplex_mode
options.description: Select the type of data transmission for the NIC.

options.name: enable_dhcp
options.description: Allows to enable or disable Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) in iDRAC.

options.name: enable_ipv4
options.description: Allows to enable or disable IPv4 configuration.

options.name: enable_nic
options.description: Allows to enable or disable the Network Interface Controller (NIC) used by iDRAC.

options.name: failover_network
options.description: Select one of the remaining LOMs. If a network fails, the traffic is routed through the failover network.

options.name: idrac_ip
options.description: iDRAC IP Address.

options.name: idrac_password
options.description: iDRAC user password. If the password is not provided, then the environment variable E(IDRAC_PASSWORD) is used. Example: export IDRAC_PASSWORD=password

options.name: idrac_port
options.description: iDRAC port.

options.name: idrac_user
options.description: iDRAC username. If the username is not provided, then the environment variable E(IDRAC_USERNAME) is used. Example: export IDRAC_USERNAME=username

options.name: ip_address
options.description: Enter a valid iDRAC static IPv4 address.

options.name: network_speed
options.description: Select the network speed for the selected NIC.

options.name: nic_mtu
options.description: Maximum Transmission Unit of the NIC.

options.name: nic_selection
options.description: Select one of the available NICs.

options.name: register_idrac_on_dns
options.description: Registers iDRAC on a Domain Name System (DNS).

options.name: setup_idrac_nic_vlan
options.description: Allows to configure VLAN on iDRAC.

options.name: share_mnt
options.description: (deprecated)Local mount path of the network share with read-write permission for ansible user. This option is mandatory for network shares. This option is deprecated and will be removed in the later version.

options.name: share_name
options.description: (deprecated)Network share or a local path. This option is deprecated and will be removed in the later version.

options.name: share_password
options.description: (deprecated)Network share user password. This option is mandatory for CIFS share. This option is deprecated and will be removed in the later version.

options.name: share_user
options.description: (deprecated)Network share user name. Use the format 'user@domain' or 'domain\user' if user is part of a domain. This option is mandatory for CIFS share. This option is deprecated and will be removed in the later version.

options.name: static_dns
options.description: Enter the static DNS domain name.

options.name: static_dns_1
options.description: Enter the preferred static DNS server IPv4 address.

options.name: static_dns_2
options.description: Enter the preferred static DNS server IPv4 address.

options.name: static_gateway
options.description: Enter the static IPv4 gateway address to iDRAC.

options.name: static_net_mask
options.description: Enter the static IP subnet mask to iDRAC.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The socket level timeout in seconds.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), the SSL certificates will not be validated. Configure C(false) only on personally controlled sites where self-signed certificates are used. Prior to collection version C(5.0.0), the I(validate_certs) is C(false) by default.

options.name: vlan_id
options.description: Enter the VLAN ID.  The VLAN ID must be a number from 1 through 4094.

options.name: vlan_priority
options.description: Enter the priority for the VLAN ID. The priority value must be a number from 0 through 7.
